literal_manuscript_lemma: \begin{lemma}[Comparison with a tilting origin fibre] \label{lem:formal-comparison} Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of arbitrary positive characteristic. Let $\mathcal N$ be a $G$-equivariant vector bundle on $V$, and suppose that its origin fibre $T=\mathcal N_0$ is a tilting $G$-module. Then \[ \mathcal N_{e_1}\cong T|_U \] as rational $U$-modules over $k$. \end{lemma}
